usage: cox stats tiers [-h] [--db DB] [--since SINCE] [--min-samples MIN_SAMPLES] [--json]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --db DB
  --since SINCE         keep only rows dated on or after DATE (YYYY-MM-DD)
  --min-samples MIN_SAMPLES
                        tasks a model needs before it can be picked (default 20)
  --json
